name: 中山大学
character: The main campus, Kangleyuan, features many Western classical buildings, including Qing-era halls, alongside squares, pavilions, and trees.

landmarks.name: 马丁堂
landmarks.quote: 其中最著名的应属建于清代的马丁堂
landmarks.look: Western classical Qing-era building with 'AD1905' stone and chimneys removed.

landmarks.name: 格兰堂
landmarks.quote: 格兰堂：即大钟楼，现学校就业指导中心、本科招生办、校友会、教学评估中心等行政部门办公所在地
landmarks.look: Western classical clock tower hall with damaged stone pillars and added floor.

landmarks.name: 怀士堂
landmarks.look: Western classical small auditorium with diamond patterns on the exterior facade.

landmarks.name: 永芳堂
landmarks.quote: 永芳堂：首层是图书馆、阅览室，二楼是办公室，三楼是孙中山纪念馆
landmarks.look: Symmetrical square-outside, round-inside building with two wings and sixty outdoor steps.

landmarks.name: 十八先贤铜像广场
landmarks.name_en: Square of Eighteen Pioneers' Bronze Statues
landmarks.quote: 十八先贤铜像广场：位于永芳堂前，由姚美良捐资100万元兴建
landmarks.look: Plaza in front of Yongfang Hall lined with eighteen bronze statues.

landmarks.name: 惺亭
landmarks.quote: 惺亭：东对图书馆，西对乙丑进士坊，南迎孙中山雕像
landmarks.look: Traditional pavilion with a calligraphy plaque, facing the library and statue.

landmarks.name: 乙丑进士坊
landmarks.quote: 乙丑进士坊：原是中华中路四牌楼的其中一座，原位于格兰堂西侧
landmarks.look: Restored historic stone archway over 370 years old, west of Grant Hall.

landmarks.name: 新图书馆
landmarks.quote: 中山大学新图书馆东北角的树丛里
landmarks.look: University library building with trees at its northeast corner.
